reader_summary.headline: Today, we are breaking down the technology conglomerate Samsung.
reader_summary.overview: Today, we are breaking down the technology conglomerate Samsung. Only Apple, Microsoft, Google, and Amazon ranked higher than Samsung in Interbrand's latest brand value rankings. It's everywhere around us: our phones, our TVs, our refrigerators, our washing machines.

key_points.text: Only Apple, Microsoft, Google, and Amazon ranked higher than Samsung in Interbrand's latest brand value rankings.
But, it's not those finished products that drive the majority of Samsung's profits.
To break down Samsung, I'm joined by David Samra, Managing Director and Founding Partner of the Artisan Partners International Value Team.
